title: Playboy Magazine October 1988 Special College Issue Centerfold
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, October 1988 -- Special College Issue: Girls, Football, Fashion, Prize Fiction, Beer. Also inside: an interview with baseball's Roger Craig, the first Reagan-Iran arms deal exclusive, Morton Downey Jr., and new work from Studs Terkel.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage. Please review photos carefully for exact condition.
